quest.title: Cooking, the Aroma of Homecoming
quest.description: According to Arachatora, his brother Arapas is doing "cooking training" close to Apam Woods. Look for a pillar of smoke near Apam Woods!
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2, Recipe: Masala Cheese Balls x1

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, what's cooking in there? Paimon's mouth is watering from just a whiff of it!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It looks like some kind of soup. Hmm... Paimon can't tell what's inside...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hey, {NICKNAME}...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What is it?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The person cooking it isn't here, and it smells so good. Let's have a mouthful while it's left unattended.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yay!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: The pot is smaller than it looks.\nThe soup within it is all gone just like that.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ahh... Huh? It smells good, but why doesn't Paimon taste anything?
Great Aramuhukunda! What are you Nara doing!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: A—Aranara? Where did you come from?

response.speaker: Arapas
response.text: From underground! Forget that, why are you drinking my soup? Arapas worked very hard on that!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sorry...

response.speaker: Arapas
response.text: Hmph! You stole my soup! Sorry won't cut it!

response.speaker: Arapas
response.text: Do you know how difficult it is to make soup here? One minute it's rainy; one minute it's sunny.

response.speaker: Arapas
response.text: I finally managed to make this pot of soup, but while I was away picking Fresh Harra Fruits, you...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It smelled too good to resist...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But if it's that difficult, why are you cooking here?

response.speaker: Arapas
response.text: Hmph! The key to cooking must be collected every day, which is...

response.speaker: Arapas
response.text: Water! It's water! Water has a huge impact on the aroma of my soup. So it has to be made with the best water!

response.speaker: Arapas
response.text: I've been collecting water throughout Apam Woods to make soup with. After collecting water samples as numerous as the leaves on a tree, I finally found the best "Living Spring."

response.speaker: Arapas
response.text: It's the only water source fit for Festival Utsava's supreme delicacy! You wouldn't get it even if I told you... Only that Nara from before...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Speaking of which, Arapacati sent us...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You bring Arapas up to speed on the events so far...

response.speaker: Arapas
response.text: Ah, you're Nara friends of my sister! And Festival Utsava is coming!

response.speaker: Arapas
response.text: It's fine. I've found Living Spring, and my Supreme Delicacy is complete. It's in this pot... Oh, right...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh-hehe... Don't be sad, at least your soup was really aromatic...

response.speaker: Arapas
response.text: Ah! My Living Spring! "Apshvaana" live at its source. I waited so long for them to leave and only collected a pot of it...

response.speaker: Arapas
response.text: No! You must get me another pot of Living Spring!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "Apshvaana"? What's that?

response.speaker: Arapas
response.text: Hmph! You Nara really know nothing about the forest. They live in the water, and they have four legs, a tail, and they bite.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Dogs?

choices.text: Dogs don't live in the water.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah, right. Then what's an "Apshvaana"?

response.speaker: Arapas
response.text: Forget that! I want my water! And I want Living Spring from there in particular!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Alright, alright... {NICKNAME}, we don't have a choice here. Let's go...

response.speaker: Arapas
response.text: It must be Living Spring and no other!

choices.text: The will to never forget your dreams?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Hey! {NICKNAME}, how could you betray Paimon like that!?

response.speaker: Arapas
response.text: I don't care who drank it! My soup is gone!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon is just so curious. Uh, Paimon will just take one mouthful, just one!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What if you get a tummy ache after?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmph! Don't you underestimate Paimon!

talks.objective: Investigate the pot emitting the aroma

dialogues.speaker: Arapas
dialogues.text: Hmm... It is the water from the river's source. The Living Spring that's cold and clean, just like moonlight.

dialogues.speaker: Arapas
dialogues.text: Arachatora, Arasaka, and Araphala wouldn't be so stupid if they grew up drinking this water. Only Arapacati, my sister...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, what's next...

dialogues.speaker: Arapas
dialogues.text: Huh? Oh. Next up, you have to make me a new pot of soup...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Receiving guidance from Arapas, you add some fruits and vegetables into the water and start cooking.\nA rather nice aroma slowly emerges from the pot.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text:
Once you're done, you taste the fresh soup together.
It sort of lives up to your expectations. It does carry the aroma of the ingredients...
But a soup without any condiments is just too plain.
It has no flavor at all.

dialogues.speaker: Arapas
dialogues.text: Mmm, this is how the supreme delicacy should smell!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hmm... What do you think, {NICKNAME}?

choices.text: It can quench thirst as soups should.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon thinks it would be better with some salt and pepper.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Everything is better with salt and pepper.

response.speaker: Arapas
response.text: Great Aramuhukunda! You want to add salt? What a horrifying idea!

response.speaker: Arapas
response.text: Land with salt is land without life, and Aranara will be forced to shrink into seeds. Yet Nara wish to add salt!?

response.speaker: Arapas
response.text: Soups are supposed to be bland! How do you Nara not even understand that!?

response.speaker: Arapas
response.text: That Nara from before told us a story after having a bowl of my soup:

response.speaker: Arapas
response.text: "When we Nara children come home, the aroma of soup is the first thing we smell. As such, aroma is all a soup needs."

response.speaker: Arapas
response.text: #After that, {F#he}{M#she} complimented the aroma of the soup I made. I've never forgotten that. That's why I won't believe a word you say!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But just aroma isn't enough...

response.speaker: Arapas
response.text: Hmph! But since you're the Nara of this Festival Utsava, I'm sure you've received approval from Araja and Arapacati. So... I'll try making a soup with taste.

response.speaker: Arapas
response.text: Next time, I'll look for even better water, so we can make even better soup!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: ...I don't think water is the problem.

response.speaker: Arapas
response.text: Really? Anyway, my cooking training has concluded. Alright, let's see what we can do about this at Festival Utsava!

response.speaker: Arapas
response.text: I've taught you how to make the soup. It's a soup approved by the Great Nara, so do give it a few more tries. But make sure you don't forget to use good water!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #({NICKNAME}, let's add some seasoning next time. It should be pretty good after that...)

choices.text: It's too healthy for me, I think...

dialogues.speaker: Arapas
dialogues.text: Is there water that can give taste to soup?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Actually, it was us...

response.speaker: Arapas
response.text: Hmph! I'm sure it was a good Nara like that Nara who repaired Varuna Contraption! It wasn't soup thieves like the two of you...

dialogues.speaker: Arapas
dialogues.text: My soup... *sob* How could this happen...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Leave quietly...)

dialogues.speaker: Arapas
dialogues.text: Hmph! Both of you are bad Nara! Don't even think about tricking me with water from somewhere else!

dialogues.speaker: Leaf With Careless Penmanship
dialogues.text: (A huge leaf. Someone has written on it with messy handwriting...)

dialogues.speaker: Leaf With Careless Penmanship
dialogues.text: "...The 17th time frost covered the leaves. After some tests, I noticed that water from tributaries is filled with sand and mud. It has an earthen taste. Not acceptable."

dialogues.speaker: Leaf With Careless Penmanship
dialogues.text: "...The 30th time frost covered the leaves. It's raining again. Not acceptable."

dialogues.speaker: Leaf With Careless Penmanship
dialogues.text: "...The 60th time frost covered the leaves. After some tests, I noticed that water from a river's main stem makes much more aromatic soup, but it still isn't enough. Not acceptable."

dialogues.speaker: Leaf With Careless Penmanship
dialogues.text: "...The 80th time frost covered the leaves. It rained as soon as I finished my soup. Luckily, I wore a hat. Hmm, the quality of this water isn't bad."
